card.name: Before-treatment timing words in monitoring
card.fires_on: The word 'to' after 'prior', or 'prior' itself, in instructions to monitor or give something before starting a drug. Also 'Premedicate' (the 'ed' part) and similar 'before'/'following' timing words.

modes.label: prior to
modes.description: 'prior' or the 'to' after it, in instructions to check lab tests before starting a drug.
modes.example: Monitor liver laboratory tests (AST, ALT, alkaline phosphatase and total bilirubin) prior<< to>> the start of KRAZATI

modes.label: Other timing words
modes.description: Words like 'following' or 'as' that set when monitoring happens.
modes.example: Monitor blood counts prior to treatment, during treatment, and<< as>> clinically indicated.

card.plain: It fires on wording that says something must be checked or given before starting a drug.
